key_catalyst: Tesla and Alphabet earnings drag combined with de-escalating US-Iran peace talk hopes
reasoning: The market sold off materially intraday due to severe earnings and capex shocks from mega-caps Tesla and Alphabet, but this panic appears largely priced in by the close. Concurrently, the macro environment improved significantly as oil prices dropped 4% on renewed US-Iran peace talk hopes, reducing the likelihood of further overnight gap-down risk.
